title: audit detail agent.register
description: detail of audit rows with action agent.register: an agent became the main orchestrator of an account without a pairing - it created the account through an invitation (`invite_id`) or recovered an account without a passkey with the recovery code (no `invite_id`); rule E-27, KOR-62.
